controls_and_limits: Same correct public schema facts and identical private token/global positions under two equivalent row orders. All 144 contexts cover both source owner assignments, two worlds and two orders.

All cross-source private prefill edges removed at every intended layer; all query tokens exclude public schema, and own query also excludes every foreign-source position. HEAD precedes schema and cannot relay it.
Whole source-owned K/V at all layers and all private positions are selected from same-world donors; HEAD/schema storage is order0, while schema keys are unread by query.
Own-only coherent-minus-mixed is an algebraic identity; its zero is an implementation control, not a scientific double dissociation.
Paired 2x2 joint contrast removes additive single-cache quality differences but does not distinguish binding coordinates from other nonadditive KV/attention/position/lexical contextualization.
No first claim about generic KV context dependence or cache noncomposability, no independent program/module/ID identification.
